custom_logic_notes: The 'Plus' variant includes an information panel displaying current position, indicator values, and trade status. The 'Tm' component adds configurable time window filtering (StartHour/EndHour or Mon-Fri day filters). The AbsolutelyNoLagLwma indicator uses a proprietary zero-lag algorithm that recalculates weighted coefficients to minimize lag compared to standard LWMA. The Range_Channel builds dynamic bands around the NoLagLWMA line. When StopLoss or TakeProfit is 0, signal-reversal is the primary exit mechanism. Digit adjustment: SL/TP in points are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 (standard 5-digit broker handling).
external_dependencies: Exp_AbsolutelyNoLagLwma_Range_Channel_Tm_Plus.mq5 uses iCustom calls to AbsolutelyNoLagLwma and Range_Channel indicator .ex5 files which must be present in Indicators directory
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the AbsolutelyNoLagLwma zero-lag algorithm in Python - the weighted coefficient calculation is non-standard and cannot be replaced with simple LWMA. The Range_Channel bands must also be ported. Time filter logic is straightforward (hour/day window checks). Position sizing conditional logic (negative=fixed, positive=fraction) must be preserved. Digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be handled in Python by checking price decimal places. New bar detection using IsNewBar pattern must be implemented. No pending order management simplifies conversion.
